organizations.publicNote: House orchestra named on Odeon record labels and established as a musical corporate body in GND and LCNAF. The linked recordings credit different conductors; no fixed personnel are inferred from the ensemble name.
Recording label associated with Carl Lindström AG. It is represented separately from the German parent company and from Polskie Zakłady Fonograficzne ‘Odeon’ in Warsaw.

sources.fullCitation: Jan Kiepura with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Dr. Weissmann. “Ninon”, from Ein Lied für dich; music by Walter Jurmann and Dr. Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter and Ernst Marischka. YouTube transfer published by 78Upm; the upload describes an Odeon red-label issue and gives the year as 1933.

sources.researchNote: The upload describes a red-label Odeon issue of 1933 with Jan Kiepura and the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Dr. Weissmann, but gives no catalogue or matrix number and does not show the disc label. These remain uploader-supplied issue and credit details. A separate catalogue source documents Kiepura’s Odeon O-4661, matrix Be 10221; without matching label or matrix evidence, that pressing is not assigned to this transfer.
